channel.title: Farrelly Atkinson Limited - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Farrelly Atkinson Limited (road.cc)

item.title: Canyon Citylite:ON
item.description: Impressive, low maintenance, high performance city bike, undermined by a problematic front light 7/10

item.title: A beautiful Colnago track bike built to Eddy Merckx's 1972 Hour Record dimensions
item.description: While Tadej Pogačar's Tour-winning Y1Rs selling for almost $200,000 made the big headlines this week, this restored Colnago also went under the hammer

item.title: Altura Nightvision Storm Men's Waterproof Jacket
item.description: Good detailing and excellent waterproofing but middling breathability and the lack of hip pockets may limit its appeal 6/10

item.title: Scribe claims new Ultra wheels are "the fastest UCI road compliant wheelset currently available"
item.description: Scribe reckons the new wheels push the boundaries of speed, low weight and high-tech, featuring a wavy spoke design and claimed weights from 1,150g per pair

item.title: “Zig zag lines, parallel crossing, I have no idea what any of it means”: Cyclists call for “regular compulsory retests” for motorists after driver ignores bike crossing; Onley/Ineos rumours; Bouhanni’s fast marathon; ‘Cross glamour + more on the live blog
item.description: After finally (and rather reluctantly) putting his Christmas tree up at the weekend, road.cc’s resident Grinch Ryan is back enjoying his own version of some proper festive fun: droning on about cycling on the Monday live blog

item.title: “It shouldn’t be a taboo. It belongs in the sport”: Lotte Kopecky pushes to remove shame around menstruation in cycling
item.description: The two-time world champion spoke about stigma surrounding menstruation, saying male coaches should “immerse” themselves in it, as “it’s part of the job”

item.title: Off-road bikes are going back to the future, and I’m here for it
item.description: Michael might not be buying into all of the latest trends, so it's a good job that some older tech is making a comeback. Just with newer names...

item.title: Amsterdam mulls over 'fat bike' ban — but will tyre width restriction really help protect city's famous bike lanes from threat of illegally modified e-bikes?
item.description: The Dutch cycling utopia is under threat from modified e-bikes. Is a ban based on tyre width really the best compromise? It's a little complicated, as we've been finding out

item.title: Councillor raising funds for legal battle against congestion charge… by cycling
item.description: Councillor David Henwood - who was found to have harassed a Labour councillor in online spats over traffic measures in Oxford - plans to cycle every day until Christmas to raise money for Open Roads in a legal challenge against Oxfordshire Council

item.title: Garmin's latest power meter pedals, a £325 front light from Exposure + more cool things from Rapha, Oquo and Magicshine
item.description: This week’s line-up includes a £325 smart front light, updated Rapha winter tights, pro-level Oquo wheels and Magicshine’s photochromic glasses
